scope_decision: Implement the smallest stable reusable article-flow improvements proved useful by the first live trial; preserve operator-owned judgment and defer platform-scale orchestration that is not needed for v1.
implemented: A raw sentence or paragraph starts a resumable run through the canonical global command and remains visible in a compact run index.
The run index exposes the canonical process, captured-material, publication, run-state, and live-link locations without adding another database or dashboard.
Article, title, and description voice are reviewed together; high-confidence formulaic display text is blocked, and title or description repairs do not replay completed upstream work.
Repairs return to the smallest responsible stage, clear that stage's exhausted counters, and preserve completed upstream artifacts.
Same-route verification is allowed only with a disclosed independence limitation when no alternative route exists, and a transport failure is not mislabeled as a broken source.

Publication checks push capability before mutation, emits one resumable credential handoff when required, and accepts a handoff only when the approved blobs match the current remote publication-branch head.
Exact live bytes and all required discovery surfaces remain the final completion gate.
operator_owned_proof_obligations: Define what belongs inside and outside the journey being documented.
Judge passage-specific voice fit and promote a voice profile only after a held-out comparison.
Confirm intent, article recipe, proofreading revisions, and each scoped publication.
Run the finalized command from each agreed fresh AI environment and report any product-specific invocation failure.
deferred_from_v1: A separate workflow service, queue, database, dashboard, or orchestration platform.
Provider ranking without operator-calibrated evaluation evidence.
Automatic voice-profile learning without explicit author confirmation.
Copied product-specific prompts, skills, or command implementations.
Approval attestation infrastructure beyond the existing hashed scoped receipts and event chain.
